app.title: Houseiana Hotels — Owner Dashboard
app.description: Create and manage your hotels, rooms, rates and bookings.

auth.gateBody: This dashboard is restricted to hotel owners and platform admins.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.mockAuthNotice: The dashboard is running on mock data, so sign-in accepts any credentials. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_MOCK=false to authenticate against the Houseiana API.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: How your properties are performing right now.
overview.recentBookingsEmpty: No bookings yet. They will appear here as guests book.
overview.alertsEmpty: Nothing needs your attention. Everything looks healthy.

alerts.draftHotel: "{name}" is still a draft and is not bookable.
alerts.unansweredReviews: {count, plural, one {# review is} other {# reviews are}} waiting for a reply.
alerts.lowInventory: {hotel} is close to sold out on {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} this month.
alerts.payoutMissing: Add your payout details to receive money from bookings.
alerts.noRatePlans: "{hotel}" has no priced room types, so guests cannot book it.
alerts.overviewAccountWide: These figures cover your whole account — the API reports them per account, not per hotel.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.subtitle: Every property on your account.
hotels.roomTypesCount: {count, plural, one {# room type} other {# room types}}
hotels.emptyBody: Create your first property to start taking bookings on Houseiana.
hotels.emptyFilteredBody: Try a different search term or clear the filters.
hotels.deleteConfirmBody: This removes the property, its room types and its rate plans. Bookings are kept for your records. This cannot be undone.
hotels.feesSubtitle: Services guests can pay for on top of the room rate.
hotels.feesEmpty: No extras yet. Add one so guests can see what else you offer.
hotels.feeCustomHint: Only "Other" needs a name — the rest are named by the service you picked.
hotels.feeMockNote: Extras are only available against the live API.
hotels.restoreConfirmBody: The hotel goes back to the state it had before it was deleted. You can delete it again afterwards.
hotels.deletedAlready: This hotel is deleted. Restore it before you can edit or publish it.
hotels.houseRulesNone: No house rules set for this hotel yet.
hotels.servicesNone: No paid services listed for this hotel.
hotels.childrenNoBands: Children are welcome; no pricing bands set.

wizard.minutesAgo: {count, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
wizard.exitConfirm: Leave the wizard? Your draft is saved automatically.
wizard.stepIssues: {count, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}} to fix

basics.title: Basic information
basics.subtitle: The essentials guests see first.
basics.name: Hotel name
basics.descriptionPlaceholder: A short description guests will see…
basics.currencyHint: All prices for this hotel are stored in this currency.
basics.cancellationPlaceholder: e.g. Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in
basics.childrenPolicyPlaceholder: e.g. Children under 6 stay free in an existing bed
basics.paymentNotePlaceholder: e.g. Card required at booking, charged at the property
basics.petsAllowedHint: Shown as a badge on the guest page.
basics.smokingAllowedHint: Applies to rooms, not outdoor areas.
basics.houseRulesHint: What guests may and may not do. Guests see these before booking.
basics.houseRulesEmpty: The server has no house rules configured yet.
basics.houseRulesNoneYet: No rules added yet. Add the ones that matter for your hotel — guests see them before booking.
basics.houseRulesAllAdded: Every rule the platform offers has been added.
basics.childrenHint: Whether children may stay, and how they are charged.
basics.childrenNotAllowedNote: This hotel does not accept children. Turn this on to set age bands and pricing.
basics.minChildAge: Youngest age counted as a child
basics.maxChildAge: Oldest age counted as a child
basics.childAgeHint: Anyone above this age is charged as an adult.
basics.childrenNoBands: No pricing bands yet. Add one to say how a child is charged.
basics.bandHint: Which child, what age range, and how they are charged.
basics.ordinalHint: 1 = the first child, 2 = the second, and so on.
basics.childAgeOrder: The upper age cannot be below the lower one.
basics.childAgeOutside: This band has to sit inside the hotel’s own child age range.
basics.childValueRequired: This pricing needs an amount greater than zero.
basics.childPercentRange: A discount cannot be more than 100%.
basics.childBandOverlap: This overlaps a band you already set for the same child.

location.title: Location
location.subtitle: Set the address and drop a pin — nearby places are found for you.
location.pinHint: Click anywhere on the map to place the pin.
location.nearbyHint: These come from a places lookup around your pin and are refreshed whenever you move it. They are not entered by hand.
location.nearbyEmpty: Drop a pin to discover nearby attractions, restaurants and transit.
location.nearbyCount: {count, plural, one {# place found} other {# places found}}

amenities.title: Hotel amenities
amenities.subtitle: Facility-level amenities from the shared catalogue. Room amenities come later, per room type.
amenities.servicesHint: Extras a guest pays for on top of the room rate.
amenities.servicesEmpty: The server has no services on file yet, so there is nothing to price here.
amenities.servicesAllAdded: Every service the platform offers has been added.
amenities.roomServicesHint: Extras sold with this room type.
amenities.servicePriceHint: Leave empty if the price is quoted on request.

photos.title: Photos
photos.subtitle: The first photo is the cover shown in search results.
photos.emptyBody: Add at least one photo. The first one becomes the cover.
photos.dropHint: Drag to reorder · first photo is the cover

rooms.title: Room types
rooms.subtitle: Each type carries its beds, in-room amenities, description and rate plans.
rooms.emptyBody: A hotel needs at least one room type before it can be published.
rooms.name: Room type name
rooms.inventoryHint: How many rooms of this type you have
rooms.totalBeds: {count, plural, one {# bed} other {# beds}} in total
rooms.seasonalNote: Seasonal prices and discounts are set in Pricing → Calendar.
rooms.removeRoomTypeConfirm: Remove this room type and its rate plans?
rooms.roomServicesHint: Extras sold with this room type.
rooms.servicesAllAdded: Every service the platform offers has been added.
rooms.sectionCapacityHint: how big, how many guests, how many rooms
rooms.servicePriceHint: Leave empty if the price is quoted on request.

review.title: Review & publish
review.subtitle: Check the profile, then publish to make it bookable.
review.readyBody: Everything checks out against the guest-app schema.
review.blockedTitle: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} to fix before publishing
review.blockedBody: The guest app rejects profiles that fail these checks.
review.summaryAmenities: {count, plural, one {# facility selected} other {# facilities selected}}
review.summaryPhotos: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} · cover set
review.summaryRoomsWarn: {count, plural, one {# type} other {# types}} · {room} has no rate plans

wizard.editSaveNote: Saving sends only what you changed. Rooms and rate plans are updated one by one, so a room you did not touch is left alone.
wizard.editLoading: Still loading the hotel’s categories and amenities — saving now would blank them. Try again in a moment.
wizard.savePartial: Saved {done} of {total} changes. The rest did not go through: {first}

warning.coverPhotoNeedsUpload: The cover photo stays as it was — the API can only set a cover from a newly uploaded file, not from a photo it already holds.

wizard.childModeUnknown: One of the children age bands uses a pricing mode the server no longer offers, so the children policy was left untouched.
wizard.ratePlanIncomplete: This rate plan has no price yet, so it was not saved.
wizard.localDraftNote: You are looking at an unsaved draft kept in this browser, not the copy on the server. If the hotel was changed elsewhere since, saving will write your version over it.
wizard.localDraftDiscard: Discard the draft and reload the server copy

pricing.title: Pricing & availability
pricing.subtitle: Nightly rates, inventory and seasonal discounts, per room type.
pricing.formula: each cell: available = total units − sold − blocked
pricing.bulkSubtitle: Applies to the selected room type. Leave a field empty to keep it unchanged.
pricing.priceWithoutDiscountHint: Shown struck through on the guest page.
pricing.discountHint: Guest sees the discounted price and the saving.
pricing.blockUnitsHint: Rooms held back from sale, e.g. for maintenance.
pricing.applied: {count, plural, one {# night updated} other {# nights updated}}
pricing.noRoomTypes: This hotel has no room types yet.
pricing.noRoomTypesAction: Add room types in the wizard
pricing.selectHotelFirst: Choose a hotel to manage its calendar.
pricing.priceAppliesTo: Applies to the {plan} rate plan only — other plans keep their own price.
pricing.clearPriceHint: These nights go back to the {plan} plan’s base price.
pricing.blockUnitsApiHint: How many of the {total} units to hold back. Zero frees the dates again.
pricing.needsRatePlan: This room type has no rate plan, so there is no price to change. Add one in the hotel’s Rooms step first.
pricing.yearLocked: The calendar API only answers for {year}, so months outside it cannot be shown yet.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.subtitle: Every reservation across your properties.
bookings.emptyBody: Reservations will appear here as soon as guests book.
bookings.emptyFilteredBody: Try widening the date range or clearing the status filter.
bookings.cancelConfirmBody: The guest is notified and the nights are released back to your inventory.
bookings.readOnlyNote: Bookings are read-only here: the API has no endpoint for confirming or cancelling one.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: What guests said. Scores and comments are written by guests and cannot be edited here.
reviews.readOnlyNotice: Guest content is read-only. You can only add a reply.
reviews.basedOn: based on {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}
reviews.replyPlaceholder: Thank the guest and address their feedback…
reviews.emptyBody: Reviews appear once guests complete their stay.
reviews.selectHotelFirst: Choose a hotel to see its reviews.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Account, payouts and the defaults applied to new hotels.
settings.accountSubtitle: How Houseiana contacts you and what your dashboard defaults to.
settings.defaultCurrencyHint: Pre-selected when you create a new hotel.
settings.payoutSubtitle: Where we send your booking revenue.
settings.policiesSubtitle: Applied to every new hotel. You can override them per property in the wizard.
settings.securityBody: Your password is managed by the Houseiana account team. Contact support to change it.
settings.payoutEmpty: No payout method saved yet. Add one so bookings can be paid out.
settings.payoutLocalNote: Your display language and default check-in times are kept in this browser — the account API has no field for them.
settings.currencyNotAvailable: That currency is not one the server offers, so it was not saved. Pick another.
